summary: The 8-K reports the consummation of Mercator Acquisition Corp.'s IPO of 17,250,000 units at $10.00/unit, raising $172.5 million in gross proceeds. The filing also details the entry into ancillary agreements (underwriting, warrant, trust, registration rights, private placement warrants purchase). This is a routine SPAC IPO closing event and does not constitute a special situation such as a business combination, tender offer, or restructuring. The registrant is the blank-check issuer, and there are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions.
